selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What makes people different from other living things in this passage?
questions.answer: People have a special nature and can choose.

questions.question: What does this nature make humans want besides basic needs?
questions.answer: Beauty, decoration, and a good place in life.

questions.question: Why do people join with others in daily life?
questions.answer: They need one another’s skills and work.

questions.question: What problem happens when these powers have no set limit?
questions.answer: People can become unfair and hurt others.

questions.question: What trouble comes when these powers are not limited?
questions.answer: Aggression and wrongdoing appear.

questions.question: Why can’t each person just decide justice fully on his own?
questions.answer: Human minds alone are not enough for that.

questions.question: How does worship help at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: It keeps belief firm and reminds people again and again.

questions.question: What special gift in people is talked about first?
questions.answer: The ability to choose.

questions.question: What kinds of wishes come from that human nature?
questions.answer: Wanting good, beautiful, and fitting things.

questions.question: Why are many crafts and jobs important for people?
questions.answer: People need many things made and prepared well.

questions.question: What does the passage say society needs when people exchange the results of their work?
questions.answer: It needs justice.

questions.question: What does society need so people can share work fairly?
questions.answer: Justice.

questions.question: What is needed in society because of this danger?
questions.answer: Justice is needed.

questions.question: If you had to tell the main idea of this passage in one short sentence, what would it be?
questions.answer: Worship helps keep belief and right living strong.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is unusual about human nature?
questions.answer: It is fine and special compared with other living things.

questions.question: Why can a person not get everything ready by himself?
questions.answer: One person cannot do all the jobs and skills alone.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about working alone?
questions.answer: Working alone is not enough for human needs.

questions.question: Which two other powers are mentioned with intellect?
questions.answer: Desire and anger.

questions.question: Why is one person’s mind not enough to make full justice?
questions.answer: One person cannot fully understand justice by himself.

questions.question: Why is a broad law needed for justice?
questions.answer: Because individual minds cannot fully measure it.

questions.question: What helps people follow commands and stay away from forbidden things?
questions.answer: Keeping Allah’s greatness before them.

questions.question: What does the passage say about humans compared with animals and other living beings?
questions.answer: Humans are set apart by a special nature.

questions.question: Why do many skills and jobs become necessary?
questions.answer: People need many things prepared well for their lives.

questions.question: What keeps belief strong in people’s minds?
questions.answer: A repeated reminder, which is worship.
